location.en: Lantern Park, the campfire circle by the lake

goal.en: Debate remote work versus the office with Owen, clearly and politely.
goal.zh: 和歐文辯論遠距工作與進辦公室，立場清楚又不失禮。

background: lakeside campfire circle at night, a large bonfire in a stone ring, log benches arranged in a circle, string lights in maple trees, dark calm lake with distant shore lights

intro.en: Debate night at Campfire Chat. Ember has drawn two names from a hat: yours and Owen's.
intro.zh: 營火英語社的辯論之夜。安柏從帽子裡抽出兩個名字：你和歐文。

intro.en: Tonight's topic: remote work or the office? Owen argues for remote, Kai for the office. Keep it friendly!
intro.zh: 今晚的題目：遠距工作還是進辦公室？歐文支持遠距，凱支持辦公室。大家友善辯論喔！

intro.en: Prepare to lose, Kai. Nicely, of course.
intro.zh: 準備好輸吧，凱。當然是很有禮貌地輸。

lines.en: Kai, you're up first. Why should people work in the office?
lines.zh: 凱，你先開始。為什麼大家應該進辦公室工作？

choices.en: In my opinion, the office builds real teamwork. You learn faster in person.
choices.zh: 我認為辦公室能建立真正的團隊合作，面對面學得更快。
choices.tip: In my opinion, ... 開頭表明立場，接著馬上給一個理由，論點就站得住。

choices.en: In my opinion, office can build the teamwork. People learn more fast together.
choices.zh: 我認為辦公室可以建立團隊合作，大家在一起學得比較快。

lines.en: "More fast"? I think you mean "faster." One point to remote work!
lines.zh: More fast？我想你是說 faster。遠距工作先得一分！

story.en: Owen scores his first point using your grammar. The audience laughs, and you spend the next round recovering.
story.zh: 歐文拿你的文法拿下第一分。觀眾笑成一片，你整回合都在找回氣勢。

fail.why: 短形容詞比較級加 -er：fast → faster，不說 more fast。the office 也要加冠詞，teamwork 是不可數名詞，不加 the。

choices.en: Honestly, people who work from home are just lazy. That's my whole point.
choices.zh: 老實說，在家工作的人就是懶。這就是我的論點。

lines.en: Wow. I work from home, Kai. Thanks for that.
lines.zh: 哇。我就在家工作耶，凱。謝謝喔。

story.en: Half the circle works from home. The friendly debate becomes a very quiet campfire.
story.zh: 營火圈裡有一半的人在家工作。友善的辯論，變成非常安靜的營火。

fail.why: 辯論要攻擊論點，不是攻擊人。說 lazy 這類評價很失禮。用理由支持立場：In my opinion, the office builds teamwork.。

lines.en: But commuting wastes hours every day. At home, I'm way more productive.
lines.zh: 可是通勤每天浪費好幾個小時。在家我的效率高多了。

lines.en: Kai, your response?
lines.zh: 凱，你怎麼回應？

choices.en: That's a fair point. On the other hand, it's harder to switch off at home.
choices.zh: 這點很有道理。但另一方面，在家比較難切換回下班模式。
choices.tip: 先用 That's a fair point. 承認對方有理，再用 On the other hand 提出反面，有禮又有力。

choices.en: Your point has a little reason. But at home, work and life mix together.
choices.zh: 你說的有點道理。但在家的話，工作和生活會混在一起。

lines.en: My point has... a little reason? Is that a compliment?
lines.zh: 我的論點有……一點理由？這是在稱讚我嗎？

story.en: Owen can't decide if you agreed with him. Neither can the audience. Your good counterpoint gets lost in the confusion.
story.zh: 歐文搞不清楚你是不是同意他，觀眾也是。你很好的反駁就這樣淹沒在困惑裡。

fail.why: 「有點道理」直譯 has a little reason 不是英文說法。要說 That's a fair point. 或 You have a point.。

choices.en: Speaking of commuting, the number 9 bus is always late, isn't it? Terrible!
choices.zh: 說到通勤，9 號公車總是誤點，對吧？超爛的！

lines.en: Ha, true, but... can we get back to the debate?
lines.zh: 哈，是沒錯，不過……我們可以回到辯論嗎？

story.en: The whole circle starts complaining about the number 9 bus. It's the most united everyone has been all night, but nobody remembers the topic.
story.zh: 整個營火圈開始抱怨 9 號公車。這是今晚大家最團結的時刻，但沒人記得題目是什麼。

fail.why: 辯論時要回應對方的論點，不要被關鍵字帶走。可以說 That's a fair point. On the other hand...。

lines.en: Switch off? I just close my laptop. Easy.
lines.zh: 切換？我把筆電闔上就好啦，簡單。

lines.en: Ooh. Kai, can you give us a real example?
lines.zh: 喔喔。凱，你能舉個實際例子嗎？

choices.en: Sure. At Brightway, my best ideas came from chats by the coffee machine.
choices.zh: 當然。在 Brightway，我最好的點子都是在咖啡機旁聊出來的。
choices.tip: 用親身經驗當例子，比空泛的說法更有說服力。

choices.en: Everybody knows the office is better. My parents always say so, too.
choices.zh: 大家都知道辦公室比較好，我爸媽也一直這樣說。

lines.en: Your parents? With respect, that's not really an argument.
lines.zh: 你爸媽？恕我直言，這不太算是論點。

story.en: The audience giggles. Owen wins the round without saying another word.
story.zh: 觀眾偷笑。歐文一句話都不用說，就拿下這一回合。

fail.why: 在英語辯論中，「大家都知道」或「長輩說的」不算證據。要用具體例子或數據支持：At Brightway, my best ideas came from...。

choices.en: For example, in Brightway my best idea come from talking at coffee machine.
choices.zh: 例如在 Brightway，我最好的點子來自在咖啡機旁聊天。

lines.en: Your best idea come from... the coffee machine talking? That's a smart machine.
lines.zh: 你最好的點子來自……會說話的咖啡機？那台機器真聰明。

story.en: Owen gets a big laugh. You had a good example, but the grammar made it sound like science fiction.
story.zh: 歐文贏得滿堂笑聲。你的例子本來很好，但文法讓它聽起來像科幻小說。

fail.why: 過去的經驗用過去式 came；公司前面用 at：at Brightway；咖啡機要加冠詞：by the coffee machine。

lines.en: Okay, I'll give you that. But not everyone can afford to live near the city center.
lines.zh: 好，這點我承認。但不是每個人都住得起市中心附近。

lines.en: Ooh, good one. Kai?
lines.zh: 喔，好問題。凱？

choices.en: Fair enough. Maybe the best answer is a mix, like three office days a week.
choices.zh: 有道理。也許最好的答案是混合制，例如一週進辦公室三天。
choices.tip: Fair enough. 承認對方說得對，再提出折衷方案，是成熟的辯論方式。

choices.en: Well, that's really their problem. They should just move closer, then.
choices.zh: 嗯，那是他們自己的問題，搬近一點就好啦。

lines.en: Just move? On what salary, Kai?
lines.zh: 搬近一點？靠什麼薪水，凱？

story.en: Someone in the circle mutters about rent prices. You lose the audience, and possibly a few friends.
story.zh: 營火圈裡有人小聲抱怨房租。你失去了觀眾，可能還失去了幾個朋友。

fail.why: 對別人的困難說「那是他們的問題」，聽起來冷漠又高傲。先承認：Fair enough.，再提出折衷方案。

choices.en: I agree you partly. Maybe the best way is mixing, three days in the office.
choices.zh: 我部分同意你。也許最好的方式是混合，三天進辦公室。

lines.en: You "agree me"? You mean agree WITH me? I'll take it!
lines.zh: 你 agree me？你是說 agree WITH me 吧？那我收下了！

story.en: Owen tells everyone you agreed with him. Technically, you did. Your compromise idea gets buried under his victory dance.
story.zh: 歐文跟大家宣布你同意他了。技術上來說，你確實同意了。你的折衷方案被他的勝利舞蓋過。

fail.why: agree 後面接人要加 with：I partly agree with you.。也可以用更簡潔的 Fair enough.。

lines.en: Honestly? Kai made me rethink a few things. Good debate.
lines.zh: 說真的？凱讓我重新思考了一些事。很棒的辯論。

lines.en: Kai, your closing words?
lines.zh: 凱，你的結語呢？

choices.en: Thanks, Owen. You argued really well. We both made good points.
choices.zh: 謝謝你，歐文。你辯得很好，我們都提出了好論點。
choices.tip: 辯論結束時稱讚對手（You argued really well.），是英語文化中的運動家精神。

choices.en: Thanks! So that means I won, right? Ember, go ahead and announce it.
choices.zh: 謝啦！所以是我贏了吧？安柏，快宣布吧。

lines.en: Hmm. I think the audience just changed their minds.
lines.zh: 嗯……我覺得觀眾剛剛改變心意了。

story.en: Owen was gracious. You were not. The vote goes to Owen, mostly for his manners.
story.zh: 歐文很有風度，你沒有。投票結果歐文獲勝，主要是因為他的風度。

fail.why: 對手剛稱讚你，你卻急著宣布自己贏，顯得沒有風度。回敬對方：Thanks, Owen. You argued really well.。

choices.en: No, no, my English is so bad. Owen is much, much better than me.
choices.zh: 沒有啦，我的英文很爛。歐文比我好太多了。

lines.en: Kai, you just debated for ten minutes in English! Own it!
lines.zh: 凱，你剛剛用英文辯論了十分鐘耶！要有自信！

story.en: The audience was about to vote for you. Then you told them not to. They listened.
story.zh: 觀眾本來要投給你，然後你叫他們不要。他們照做了。

fail.why: 在英語文化中，過度自謙常被當真，或讓對方不知如何回應。接受肯定並回敬對方：Thanks, Owen. We both made good points.。

lines.en: What a debate! A year ago, Kai barely said a word at this campfire. Look at you now!
lines.zh: 多精彩的辯論！一年前，凱在營火旁幾乎不敢開口。看看現在！

lines.en: Rematch next week. I'm bringing statistics.
lines.zh: 下週再戰。我會帶數據來。

story.en: You disagreed clearly, gave real examples, and kept it friendly. Nobody really won, and that's exactly why everyone enjoyed it.
story.zh: 你清楚表達不同意見、舉出實例，還保持友善。沒有人真的贏，這正是大家都樂在其中的原因。

notes.explain: 表明立場的標準開頭。說完立場後馬上接理由或例子，論點才有力。也可以說 The way I see it, ...。

example.en: In my opinion, public transport should be free.
example.zh: 我認為大眾運輸應該免費。

notes.en: That's a fair point. On the other hand, ...
notes.zh: 這點很有道理。但另一方面……
notes.explain: 先承認對方有理，再用 On the other hand 提出反面觀點。比直接說 You're wrong 有禮貌得多。

example.en: That's a fair point. On the other hand, it's more expensive.
example.zh: 這點有道理。但另一方面，它比較貴。

notes.explain: agree 是不及物動詞，接人要加 with：I agree with you.。接事情用 agree with / agree on / agree that...。

example.en: I partly agree with you, but not completely.
example.zh: 我部分同意你，但不是全部。

notes.zh: 放下工作、切換到休息模式
notes.explain: 原意是關掉開關，口語中指「下班後在心理上放下工作」。

example.en: I find it hard to switch off after work.
example.zh: 我下班後很難放下工作。

notes.explain: 英語辯論重視證據而非權威，「大家都知道」或「長輩說」不算論點。結束時稱讚對手、接受讚美，比過度自謙更得體。

example.en: Great debate. You argued really well.
example.zh: 很棒的辯論，你辯得很好。
